title: Playboy May 2007 Tribute to Anna Nicole Smith Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
description:

Also inside: Girls of Conference USA; original Star Wars storyboards (Obi-Wan lives!); Steve Nash interview; Fergie 20Q; new urban wardrobe; baseball preview.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
